On this episode of Chart Fanatics, we are joined by Gianluca Bruni, a world trading champion who achieved more than 200% in nine months and has generated multiple six-figure prop firm payouts.

Gianluca breaks down the statistical trading approach that took him from a losing discretionary trader to a world champion, including mechanical market structure, backtesting, expectancy, autocorrelation, risk models and the mathematical frameworks he uses for prop firm trading.
